canonical_project: Sinet: Phnom Penh (Sinet Cambodia data center)
notes: Baxtel lists Sinet: Phnom Penh as an operational data center (extra-small, managed-service-provider type) with a reported footprint of ~118,403 sq ft, operated by Sinet Cambodia, one of the country's main ISPs.
